blocks.heading: Readable visual-scripting workflows
blocks.body:
The Bolt 2.0 work covered UX documentation, high-fidelity interface mockups, and an icon system for Unity API functions. I created 278 icons, exported them into the engine, and iterated on their appearance in context.

The commissioned work was for Bolt. After Unity acquired Bolt from Ludiq, the icons were carried into Unity Visual Scripting.

title: BOLT.UNITY
heading: Bolt 2.0 interface and icons
description: Led UI/UX redesign work for Bolt 2.0 and created 278 icons for Unity API functions, testing the interface and symbols directly in-engine.
role: UX / UI DESIGN / ICON SYSTEM DESIGN
